__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus data source that scrapes the NUT exporter

description: UPS status, charging state, runtime (mm:ss), load, voltages, frequency and beeper status for the Prometheus NUT Exporter (romekd/prometheus-nut-exporter). Requires the Business Text panel plugin (GF_PLUGINS_PREINSTALL=marcusolsson-dynamictext-panel).

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Online with battery charge below 100% is shown as Charging. On battery and Low battery retain their UPS status. Shows "NUT unreachable" when the exporter can't reach the NUT server.

panels.title: Runtime
panels.description: Total minutes:seconds from NUT battery runtime. Requires Grafana Business Text plugin.

panels.title: Battery Charge
panels.description: Current reported battery charge. The Status panel displays Charging when the UPS is online and this value is below 100%.

panels.title: Power source (green = mains, red = on battery)
panels.description: When the UPS ran on mains (green) or on battery (red). Hover a red block to see when the outage started, ended and how long it lasted.

panels.title: Watcher
panels.description: Background outage watcher (WATCH_TARGET on the exporter): OK = polling NUT every 2 s, Failing = cannot reach NUT, Off = not enabled (short outages may be missed).

panels.title: Outages
panels.description: Number of switches to battery in the selected time range. Counts even short blips when the exporter runs with WATCH_TARGET; otherwise only outages that last across a Prometheus scrape.

targets.expr: sum by (ups) (round(increase(nut_on_battery_events_total{ups=~"${ups:pipe}"}[$__range]))) or sum by (ups) (ceil(changes(nut_ups_status{ups=~"${ups:pipe}", status="OB"}[$__range]) / 2))

panels.title: Time on battery
panels.description: Total time on battery in the selected time range. Accurate to ~2 s with WATCH_TARGET; otherwise to ~1 min and only for outages that last across a scrape.

targets.expr: sum by (ups) (increase(nut_on_battery_seconds_total{ups=~"${ups:pipe}"}[$__range])) or sum by (ups) (sum_over_time(nut_ups_status{ups=~"${ups:pipe}", status="OB"}[$__range:1m]) * 60)

panels.title: Energy (${cost_period:text})
panels.description: Energy used by the equipment on the UPS (ups.realpower) in the month chosen with "Cost period" (this month so far, or all of last month), and projected for a full month at the same average draw. Ignores the dashboard time picker.

panels.title: Cost (${cost_period:text})
panels.description: Cost for the month chosen with "Cost period" (this month so far, or all of last month), and projected for a full month: energy × "Price per kWh", minus "Discount (%)", shown in the selected Currency. Ignores the dashboard time picker.

panels.title: Power [$smoothing_interval]
panels.description: Real power drawn by the equipment connected to the UPS (ups.realpower). Not every UPS reports this.

list.name: cost_period
list.label: Cost period
list.description: Month shown by the Energy and Cost panels.

list.name: currency
list.label: Currency
list.description: Currency symbol for the Cost panel. Set Price per kWh in the same currency.

list.name: kwh_price
list.label: Price per kWh
list.description: Your electricity price per kWh, used by the Cost panel.

list.name: discount_pct
list.label: Discount (%)
list.description: Discount subtracted from the cost, in percent. Leave empty or 0 for no discount.

title: Prometheus NUT Exporter - Charging Status
